haikus.haiku:
Creamy swirl drifts up
Cool scent sweet lingers on tongue
Joyful smiles melt too
Happy #NationalSoftIce

Stale rhyme falls quiet
Ink drips on paper, sighs soft
Snow melts on bright tongue
Happy #BadPoetryDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Sunrise paints bright sky
Crickets sing, breeze hums low soft
Joyful cheers rise high
#HappyBirthdayRobertoClemente from @ClamBakeSanta
